findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_listing, list_my_listings, list_conversations, get_conversation, get_entitlements, reply_to_conversation · Private data: get_listing, send_message, create_listing, request_image_upload, reply_to_conversation, update_listing_images · Public sink: search_listings, send_message, create_listing, request_image_upload, get_entitlements, update_listing, update_listing_images · Destructive: update_listing, delete_listing, update_listing_images.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_listing, list_my_listings, list_conversations, get_conversation, get_entitlements, reply_to_conversation · Private data: get_listing, send_message, create_listing, request_image_upload, reply_to_conversation, update_listing_images · Public sink: search_listings, send_message, create_listing, request_image_upload, get_entitlements, update_listing, update_listing_images · Destructive: update_listing, delete_listing, update_listing_images

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
